children: Overview
US defense-focused REIT's Q3 net income missed analyst expectations
Diluted EPS for Q3 rose year-over-year
FFO per share grew 2.9% yr/yr and full-year FFO guidance midpoint was raised
Outlook
Company raises 2026 FFO per share guidance midpoint to $2.80
Company lifts 2026 Same Property cash NOI growth guidance midpoint to 4.25%
Company lowers 2026 tenant retention guidance midpoint to 80%
Result Drivers
TENANT DEMAND - Co said strong tenant demand for specialized space, driven by growth in defense-related programs, supported results
VACANCY LEASING - Co increased vacancy leasing target to accommodate higher growth tenants, particularly in Columbia Gateway and Huntsville
RENT INCREASES - Co reported higher rents on renewed leases, with straight-line rents up 20.3% and cash rents up 8.5% in Q3
